reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Strengthenig TB/HIV collaboration to reduce morbidity and mortality. - Liberia (01-Apr-2016-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Liberia, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health and Social Welfare (MOH)This program has the following goals: Keep PLHIV alive and healthy in Liberia. To mitigate socio-economic impact on people infected and affected by HIV and AIDS in Liberia. To reduce TB prevalence and incidence by 2018. To stop new HIV infections in Liberia. The objectives of this program are: Strengthen national health and community systems. To address TB-HIV, MDR-TB, and the needs of poor and vulnerable populations. To contribute to health system strengthening based on primary health care. To empower people with TB, and communities through partnership. To enable and promote research. To engage all care providers. To increase access to HIV prevention and treatment services. To increase care and support for PLHIV. To provide HIV prevention information and services to key and vulnerable populations. To pursue high-quality DOTS expansion and enhancement

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for LBR-C-MOHP01

Percentage of laboratories showing adequate performance in external quality assurance for smear microscopy among the total number of laboratories that undertake smear microscopy during the reporting period
Percentage of previously treated TB patients receiving DST (bacteriologically positive cases only)
Percentage of HIV-positive patients who were screened for TB in HIV care or treatment settings
Percentage of infants born to HIV-positive women receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
MDR TB-other 1: Percentage of cases with drug resistant TB (RR-TB and/or MDR-TB) started on treatment for MDR-TB who were lost to follow up during the first 12 months of treatment
Percentage of HMIS or other routine reporting units submitting timely reports according to national guidelines
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Percentage of people living with HIV currently receiving antiretroviral therapy
Percentage of HIV-positive registered TB patients given anti-retroviral therapy during TB treatment
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Percentage of pregnant women who know their HIV status
